evidence.title: Improving O-RADS Risk Stratification from Ultrasound Reports: A Comparative Evaluation of Hybrid versus End-to-End LLM Reasoning Strategies

summary: Researchers evaluated how large language model (LLM) reasoning approaches can improve O‑RADS risk stratification derived from ultrasound reports. Their comparative study found that a hybrid LLM method, which combines domain‑specific prompts with model reasoning, outperformed a fully end‑to‑end LLM pipeline in accuracy and interpretability.
title: Hybrid and End-to-End LLM Strategies Compared for Enhanced O‑RADS Risk Stratification from Ultrasound Reports
